title: Aidan is one of thousands of students forced to verbally defend his honours thesis as universities take on AI
summary_full: Honours students are increasingly being asked to sit oral assessments – but at the University of Sydney it’s become a requirement for allGet our breaking news email, free app or daily news podcastWhen Aidan Elwig Pollock signed up for an honours program at the University of Sydney, he did not expect his 20,000-word thesis to be accompanied by a spoken component.But, as AI increasingly makes written research an unreliable form of assessment, the university has demanded all students taking the one-year program defend their arguments in conversation with professors.
